findings.quote: 不能吃 means the food isn't safe or you aren't allowed to eat it
findings.problem: Overstated: 不能吃 also covers can't eat for bodily reasons (我不能吃辣), which learners will hear constantly.
findings.fix: Say 不能吃 sounds like you can't eat it at all (not safe, not allowed, or your body can't take it).
